description: This file contains the implementation of the Git::SVN::Log module, handling Subversion log operations within a Git context. It includes functions for retrieving logs, formatting dates, showing commits, and conducting blame operations.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Log
classes.description: Module implementing Subversion log operations for Git integration.

methods.name: cmt_showable
methods.description: Determines if a commit is showable based on its metadata.

methods.name: log_use_color
methods.description: Checks if color should be used in logs.

methods.name: git_svn_log_cmd
methods.description: Constructs the command for retrieving SVN logs through Git.

methods.name: config_pager
methods.description: Configures the pager program for output pagination.

methods.name: format_svn_date
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into SVN date string.

methods.name: parse_git_date
methods.description: Parses a Git date string with timezone info into a timestamp.

methods.name: set_local_timezone
methods.description: Sets the local timezone environment variable.

methods.name: tz_to_s_offset
methods.description: Converts timezone offset string to seconds.

methods.name: get_author_info
methods.description: Extracts and populates author info from log data.

methods.name: process_commit
methods.description: Processes and decides whether to show a commit based on range filters.

methods.name: show_commit
methods.description: Displays a commit in either one-line or normal format.

methods.name: show_commit_changed_paths
methods.description: Displays the changed paths of a commit.

methods.name: show_commit_normal
methods.description: Displays a detailed, normal format for a commit.

methods.name: cmd_show_log
methods.description: Implements the 'show log' command with SVN/Git integration.

methods.name: cmd_blame
methods.description: Implements the 'blame' command, showing line-by-line origin.
